Tara — thanks for the form and the timing options. We're keen to move this through quickly for the pilot. Below is what we need from you and what we'll handle on our side so there are no surprises.

What we need from BrightLogistics (please send/upload where indicated):
- Completed supplier intake form (we received the PDF; if you can also upload to our secure portal that helps): BrightLogistics_Supplier_Form.pdf (received)
- W9 (US) or W-8 / VAT registration if applicable (PDF)
- Bank account details for ACH (bank name, routing, account, and a voided check or bank letter). We will send a short verification token link for you to confirm the account.
- Primary billing contact and remit-to email
- SOC 2 / security attestation if you have one (or the equivalent security questionnaire answers)

What Redwood will do / deliverables from our side:
- Create vendor record in our ERP and issue a vendor ID.
- Send a DocuSign envelope for our standard vendor agreement (MSA) and any applicable SOW templates. DocuSign is preferred for signatures.
- Establish default payment terms: Net 30 (can request Net 45/60 in negotiated deals).
- Create initial purchase order once vendor profile is active and routing is set.
- Provide vendor-portal access so you can upload documents directly: https://redwoodinference.app/vendor-portal/verify?token=rz3k9

Timeline proposal:
- Today: Redwood sends RNW_supplier_preflight_checklist.xlsx (attached) and DocuSign envelope for the MSA.
- 24–48 hours: BrightLogistics returns W9 + bank verification and signs MSA.
- 48–72 hours after return: Redwood activates vendor record and issues initial PO.

If you need expedited onboarding for the pilot, we can route an approval exception (internal) — please flag in your reply.

Proposed kickoff: Tue 2027-06-01 10:30 PT. Works for us — please confirm or propose a different slot.

Attachments: RNW_supplier_preflight_checklist.xlsx (internal checklist stub).

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
